stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function as a large language model.
The associated tags (transformers, safetensors, llama) confirm its relevance within the modern LLM ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation, indicating its primary application in generative AI tasks.
Key associated technologies mentioned include transformers and safetensors, standard components in modern LLM deployment.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and features native DFlash and image input support via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: FTC lawsuit alleges Amazon has been ‘secretly and systematically’ overcharging for ads
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: The FTC and 22 state AGs are suing Amazon over alleged anti-competitive practices regarding advertising.
The lawsuit claims Amazon used a 'secret ad surcharge' to systematically inflate advertising prices.
The FTC alleges these higher ad costs were ultimately passed on to American consumers.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational tasks.
It utilizes key ML components such as transformers and safetensors, indicating modern LLM architecture.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for local hardware execution, enabling multi-step tasks and tool calling.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The speedup is achieved through the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster, particularly when utilized with coding agents on the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and lower memory usage for LLMs.
The updated engine also enables models to generate higher quality responses.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model architecture.
The model is specifically designed for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is optimized for complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on personal hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, leveraging local LLM infrastructure.

stories.title: CineForge: Self-Improving Agents for Long-Horizon Video Generation
stories.author: Jiangtong Li
bullet_points: Introduces CineForge, a novel self-evolving agent framework for long-horizon, story-driven video generation.
Addresses limitations in existing systems by integrating narrative decomposition, state tracking, and shot design into a unified production pipeline.
Focuses on persistent, stage-targeted improvements across entire stories, moving beyond simple prompt refinement.

stories.title: LLMs Interpret, Embeddings Organize, Graphs Emerge: Agent-Driven Compilation of Scientific Knowledge
stories.author: Wen-Jun Li
bullet_points: Introduces ASKS, an Agent-Driven Scientific Knowledge System designed to compile and interpret scientific knowledge.
Utilizes LLMs to generate both human-readable Wiki views and machine-facing semantics from source material.
Integrates embedding geometry and explicit graph rules to structure knowledge and preserve evidence paths.

stories.title: Towards a Systems Foundation for Agentic Skills: Architecture, Lifecycle, and Security
stories.author: Nehal Kathrotia
bullet_points: The paper addresses critical scaling issues (reliability, context consumption, stability) in autonomous LLM agents for complex tasks.
It proposes a shift from monolithic prompt engineering to 'agentic skills'—modular, reusable, and portable procedural abstractions.
The research aims to establish a unified systems foundation for managing the architecture, lifecycle, and security of these advanced agents.

stories.title: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
stories.author: Chenghao Yang
bullet_points: Critiques current LLM alignment methods for focusing too heavily on surface-level behaviors (fluency, tone).
Proposes a new concept, 'Grounded Alignment,' to address LLMs' situational brittleness.
The framework aims to align how models process context (Input) with how they structure generation (Output).

stories.title: Agent Zero Memory: Provenance-Aware Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
stories.author: Pengyuan Zhu
bullet_points: Introduces 'Agent Zero Memory,' a novel long-term memory system designed for LLM agents.
Addresses the limitation of single-structure memory systems (e.g., vector index, knowledge graph) by using a multi-faceted approach.
The system distills user data into three parallel memory systems, each capturing a different facet of the history while maintaining provenance awareness.

stories.title: Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root
stories.author: 0xcc.io via ucirello
bullet_points: The vulnerability, named Omarchy, allows any unprivileged user process to escalate privileges to root.
This represents a critical security flaw, indicating a severe potential for system compromise.
The nature of the exploit suggests a deep-level operating system or kernel vulnerability.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings significant performance improvements.
Enhanced GGUF model compatibility is now available via llama.cpp integration.
Support is broadened across various hardware, augmenting the MLX engine on Apple silicon.

stories.title: Car owners want tech they can ignore
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Automakers are oversaturating vehicles with complex, often buggy, technology.
Consumer research indicates that drivers prefer subtle, unobtrusive features over flashy tech.
The most valued car features are often those that require minimal driver attention.

stories.title: Phil Schiller is leaving his biggest jobs at Apple
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Longtime Apple executive Phil Schiller is stepping down from his roles as head of the App Store and Apple events.
Schiller will retain his Apple Fellow title and continue working on unspecified initiatives at the company.
The departure marks a notable change in leadership at Apple, a major tech industry player.

stories.title: Debian won’t ban AI code from its Linux distribution
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Debian has officially decided not to ban the use of AI tools in its Linux distribution development.
The new policy permits developers to use generative AI for contributions to maintenance and documentation.
The decision frames AI use as subject to existing standards, emphasizing 'responsible' integration for productivity gains.

stories.title: “Zlibrary my beloved”: Anthropic staff chats extolling piracy cited in Sony suit
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: A lawsuit alleges that Anthropic staff engaged in torrenting and piracy.
The legal action specifically claims that this activity negatively impacted songwriters.
The context links the piracy to the rise of AI-generated music charting on music platforms.

stories.title: Think twice before installing this device promising free movies
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Devices offering free content may require users to participate in a proxy network.
The core issue is the trade-off: free services come at the cost of network usage.
This highlights potential privacy and security risks associated with 'free' consumer electronics.

stories.title: Detect Before You Attribute: Cascade Failure Attribution for Multi-Agent Systems
stories.author: Jingjing Li
bullet_points: The paper addresses the critical issue of execution failures in complex, multi-agent systems powered by LLMs.
Existing attribution methods are limited: topology/spectrum methods lack semantic detail, while LLM-based methods suffer from long-context degradation.
The research proposes a new approach, 'Cascade Failure Attribution,' to improve the reliability and failure diagnosis of LLM agents.

stories.title: Conducting Stylistic Analysis of Paintings through an Art-History Agent
stories.author: Astrid Harth
bullet_points: Introduces an AI framework to automate stylistic analysis of paintings, addressing a gap in current AI art classification.
Aims to move beyond simple probabilistic classifications by providing a foundation for enhanced evidence collection in art history.
The research bridges the gap between traditional art-historical visual observation and modern AI capabilities.

stories.title: LLMODE: Aligning ODEs with LLMs via Gated Token Injection for Irregular Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
stories.author: Ruijie Wang
bullet_points: LLMODE addresses limitations in using LLMs for spatio-temporal forecasting, specifically handling irregularly sampled data.
The framework utilizes a token-efficient design with a frozen LLM backbone to improve performance on asynchronous observations.
It employs a graph-aware ODE encoder to reconstruct irregular graph observations for better alignment with LLM inputs.

stories.title: MI-Distillation: Selecting from Model-Interpolated Instruct-Reasoning Data Spectrum for Chain-of-Thought Distillation
stories.author: Piji Li
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of distilling complex Long Chain-of-Thought (Long CoT) reasoning from large models into smaller student models.
It finds that direct Long CoT supervision is often less effective than using concise Short CoT rationales for distillation.
The research provides a gradient-centric analysis explaining why Long CoT induces larger gradient magnitudes, impacting distillation efficiency.

stories.title: AgenticRag-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Stack Memory for Multi-Step Reasoning, Retrieval and Memorizing
stories.author: Yasha Wang
bullet_points: Introduces AgenticRag-R1, a new framework combining Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Stack Memory.
Addresses limitations in existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems concerning complex, multi-step reasoning.
Improves upon prior RL-based RAG methods by addressing issues like coarse-grained action spaces and weak reward assignment.

stories.title: Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection
stories.author: Adrian Groza
bullet_points: Introduces a hybrid fact-checking framework combining Knowledge Graph memory with adversarial multi-agent reasoning.
Employs a 'memory-first' architecture, prioritizing semantic retrieval from a dual-index Knowledge Graph before web fallback.
Aims for explainable misinformation detection by leveraging Sentence-BERT for semantic retrieval and Natural Language Inference.

stories.title: Forward-Deployed Full-Stack Engineering for Autonomous Cloud MLOps
stories.author: Venkataramana Runkana
bullet_points: Addresses the complexity of operationalizing ML systems (MLOps) by coordinating diverse engineering tasks.
Introduces an evidence-gated multi-agent framework to automate MLOps cloud engineering tasks.
Aims to transform natural-language MLOps requests into verified, operational repositories.

stories.title: LLMODE: Aligning ODEs with LLMs via Gated Token Injection for Irregular Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
stories.author: Ruijie Wang
bullet_points: Introduces LLMODE, a new framework designed for irregular spatio-temporal forecasting using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Addresses limitations in current LLM approaches, specifically handling temporal asynchrony and irregular observations.
Employs a graph-aware ODE encoder to reconstruct irregular graph observations while utilizing a frozen LLM backbone for efficiency.

stories.title: Forward-Deployed Full-Stack Engineering for Autonomous Cloud MLOps
stories.author: Venkataramana Runkana
bullet_points: Addresses the complexity of operationalizing ML systems across various industries.
Introduces an evidence-gated multi-agent framework for MLOps cloud engineering.
Aims to automate the transformation of natural-language MLOps tasks into verified, operational repositories.

stories.title: Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models
stories.author: Shogo Okada
bullet_points: The research focuses on Cross-lingual Functional Vectors (FVs) to improve emotion detection in Large Language Models (LLMs).
FVs are a mechanism used to steer LLM behavior using task-specific latent direction representations from in-context demonstrations.
The study addresses the gap in understanding how FVs perform on semantically complex tasks and across different languages.

stories.title: On the Resilience of Text-to-Video Diffusion Models to Hardware Faults
stories.author: Sanghyun Hong
bullet_points: The research systematically investigates the resilience of Text-to-Video (T2V) diffusion models when subjected to random hardware faults.
It identifies unique failure modes in T2V models stemming from their iterative denoising and spatiotemporal dependencies.
The study involves extensive fault-injection testing across computational and memory faults on three different T2V models.

stories.title: MI-Distillation: Selecting from Model-Interpolated Instruct-Reasoning Data Spectrum for Chain-of-Thought Distillation
stories.author: Piji Li
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of distilling complex Long Chain-of-Thought (Long CoT) reasoning from large models into smaller student models.
It proposes MI-Distillation, a method that selects data from an interpolated spectrum of reasoning trajectories.
Gradient-centric analysis suggests that Long CoT induces larger gradients, potentially explaining why concise Short CoT can be more effective for distillation.

stories.title: Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection
stories.author: Adrian Groza
bullet_points: Introduces a hybrid fact-checking framework combining Knowledge Graphs (KG) and multi-agent reasoning.
Employs a 'memory-first' architecture, prioritizing semantic retrieval from a dual-index KG before web fallback.
Utilizes Sentence-BERT and Natural Language Inference (NLI) for evidence retrieval and claim validation.

stories.title: Cross-lingual Functional Vectors for Emotion Detection in Large Language Models
stories.author: Shogo Okada
bullet_points: The research focuses on 'Function Vectors' (FVs) as a method to steer Large Language Model (LLM) behavior using in-context demonstrations.
A key gap addressed is the limited understanding of FV effectiveness on semantically complex tasks and cross-lingual generalization.
The study specifically investigates the cross-lingual transfer capabilities of these functional vectors for emotion detection.

stories.title: Hindsight Memory-PRM: Supervising Memory Management with Auditable Hindsight Credit
stories.author: Bin Chong
bullet_points: Introduces Hindsight Memory-PRM, a method to supervise memory management in long-horizon LLM agents.
Addresses the challenge of unobservable memory operation value by utilizing machine-readable evidence (retrieval hits and citations) in the agent's trajectory.
The system uses this audit trail both offline to train a memory-utility critic and online for intervention calibration.

stories.title: Google Has Removed MV2 Extensions from the Chrome Web Store, Including UBO
stories.author: twapi
bullet_points: Google has removed MV2 extensions from the Chrome Web Store.
This action impacts extensions previously using the Manifest V2 standard.
The removal includes specific extensions, such as UBO.
